corrections.issue: Overstates: the speaker did not say virtual warehousing achieves a 5-10% break-even; he said it would be desirable 'if you can turn that into a 5% break-even, 10% break-even'.
corrections.fix: Holding $3 corn via futures has historically needed about $4 to break even over 12 months (about $1 or ~30% roll cost, 2000-present); the aim of virtual warehousing is to cut that break-even to something like 5-10% so a position can be held far longer.

completeness_estimate: 0.87 - first reader caught all core mechanisms (roll vs theta, hedger-driven rich calls, payoff profile, regimes); missed the host's challenges (Ukraine spike reversal, negative oil storage, timing risk), the trend barometer reading and some caveats on margins/flows.
